   Holt of Crawfod moved that the joint resolution be read a last time
now and placed upon its adoption and the joint resolution was read a
last time.

  The joint resolution having received a constitutional majority was
declared to have been adopted and agreed to by the House.

   House File 641, a bill for an act relating to city civil service
employees and related procedures and including effective date
provisions, was taken up for consideration.

   Wengryn of Decatur offered amendment H–1235 filed by the
representative and moved its adoption.

  Amendment H–1235 was adopted, placing out of order amendment
H–1056 filed by Wengryn of Decatur on March 11, 2025, amendment
H–1059 filed by Levin of Johnson on March 11, 2025 and amendment
H–1070 filed by Wengryn of Decatur on March 12, 2025.

     SENATE FILE 311 SUBSTITUTED FOR HOUSE FILE 641

  Wengryn of Decatur asked and received unanimous consent to
substitute Senate File 311 for House File 641.
